written_by: Desi, closing item 29: two more characters, so the cast is three and three with no participant on the court
note: Who may be drawn and who may be cast, and from what. A player listed here is a CHARACTER — a game's invention, not a member of the commons — so its group, its body and its face are all part of the invention: `sex` and `look` are what the clock builds a season's setup.json from, and `face` is the sentence portrait.js draws the break card from, every time the card is drawn. A PARTICIPANT is not listed here. A participant is cast only by declaring a group in declarations.json, and is never given a height, a build, a garment or a face by me. Before 2026-11-26 the group and the body of each character lived only in a season's setup.json, which meant the clock could not open a characters-only season without copying a participant's row forward with it; now the pool is here and the setup is derived.
